description: Returns nutrition for a food from its barcode (UPC/EAN, via Open Food Facts) or its name (USDA FoodData Central): calories, protein, fat, saturated fat, carbs, sugars, fiber and sodium per 100 g or 100 ml, per serving and for gram amounts when the source uses grams, with % Daily Value from the FDA's reference values. Volume-based foods are not converted to grams without a density. Barcodes also return ingredients, allergens and Nutri-Score. When a brand is known, FDA recall reports matching it are included. A list of items (name or barcode with grams or servings, or menu items with per-serving numbers) plus optional daily targets returns the sum, % Daily Value and what remains of each target. Applies to food nutrition, ingredients or meal totals. A recall-only question is outside this result. Results are nutrition numbers and are not a statement that a food is healthy or safe. Not medical or diet advice. Medicines and cosmetics are outside this result.

amount_g.description: Amount eaten in grams, to scale the values

amount_ml.description: Amount of a drink in millilitres, when the source reports per 100 ml

barcode.description: UPC or EAN printed under the bars, 8 to 14 digits

fdc_id.description: A USDA FoodData Central id from an earlier result's alternatives

items.description: Meal items. The result is their sum.

amount_ml.description: Millilitres, when the source reports per 100 ml

name.description: Item name, e.g. 'Chipotle chicken burrito bowl'

nutrients.description: Per-serving numbers from a restaurant or brand nutrition page, in place of a lookup

query.description: Food name to look up, with brand when known
Food name, with brand when known, e.g. 'Chobani plain Greek yogurt' or 'banana'

targets.description: The person's own daily or meal targets, for what's left

name: check_food
title: Food: nutrition, ingredients and recalls
